high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified user "gisele." The post features a woman sitting on a large, white, cushioned chair placed on a sandy beach. She is wearing a black dress and has long, blonde hair. The woman appears relaxed, with her legs crossed and her head resting back slightly. The setting is a picturesque beach scene with clear blue skies and calm turquoise waters. Two tall palm trees are visible to the left of the chair, providing shade and adding to the tropical ambiance.
